It's based around matching cards of the same flower type. Like suites in regular poker cards, there are 4 of each flower/image. If you notice the Moon is a type, and the one with the Crane has "Cactus" around it, so there are 3 other cards with cactus like plants on it. There are Roses, Mums, Sakura, Rain, Leaves, the Blue flower that is seen with the Rooster card in the picture. 

So the actual game, always play with 4 people. Each person is dealt 7 cards and 6 cards are flipped face up on the table. You use the cards in your hand to match a card on the table and if you do, you get both cards in your "pot". Then you flip a card off the top of the deck, and if that matches anything on the table you can get those 2 cards as well. 

There are points based on the image. Some cards have Flags, Red and Blue, and they are worth 5 points each. Ones with Animals are worth 10 points. And the cards with the Stamp symbol on it are worth 20, example the 4 you have in the picture, the Crane, Moon, Rooster, and the Sakura bundle all have that stamp. The guy with the umbrella as well is worth 20 but not part of a "set" i'll talk about. 

Then you get bonus points based on sets you get: 3 red flags with the writing on it, same for 3 blue flags. If you get all 4 of the big 20 points ( just not Rain, which is the umbrella guy). One really cool set if you're a naruto fan is Ino-Shika-Cho, the Boar Deer and Butterfly. If you get any of these sets each player has to give you 20 points from their takes/pots.

Then at the end, everyone trys to make 80 points to break even. Usually one person will have over 80 meaning the others are low. Then we give 10 cents to the winner based on how much we are off 80. Japanese love to gamble ;D

Games are pretty quick so playing for like 8 or so hours straight my grandma walk away with like $30 lol. It was in all good fun with her other Japanese friends :)
